physics_asymptotic_result.proof: The audited canonical zero-stress cleavage barrier gives a finite raw rate for every final row. The m=3 renewal transform is strictly positive for every positive raw rate. Effective opening stress is nonnegative and the barrier rate is monotone nondecreasing with stress, so this zero-drive renewal rate is a strict positive lower bound on hazard. Therefore H_cleave(N) diverges as N approaches infinity.
